selected.initialPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a native transparent PNG atlas for a flat English-learning app. Generate EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate minimal pictograms in a strict 4-column x 4-row square grid, with generous transparent gutters. No labels, text, cell frames or background. The references indicate the simple shape vocabulary and Horizons palette only. Every image is a complete STILL graphic, never a sprite sequence or rig.
STYLE: absolutely flat solid fills, borderless shapes, very simple, crisp friendly geometric silhouettes; no outlines or strokes around silhouettes, no shadows anywhere, no gradients, modeled lighting, texture, highlights, glossy surfaces or 3D. Use saturated magenta #ad195a, orange #ff7900, teal #008f95, dark navy #163d50 and warm cream #ffe8bc. At most four colors per pictogram, consistent optical size. Minimal detail readable at24px.
ROW1 left to right:1 friendly simple house with solid window;2 open book cream pages with magenta cover;3 simple game controller with two solid buttons;4 friendly simple rounded-square human head profile symbol (open eyes, small smile, no hair shading).
ROW2:5 small orange flame;6 solid orange five-point star badge;7 simple orange trophy cup;8 small magenta satchel with navy strap and orange button.
ROW3:9 teal loudspeaker plus two solid curved sound shapes;10 simple orange key;11 magenta calendar with four square dates, no numbers;12 a teal circular compass with a single orange triangular needle (no outline).
ROW4:13 a simple solid teal settings gear;14 a simple orange flag on navy pole;15 magenta heart;16 closed teal book with simple orange plus sign.
Each pictogram fits fully in its own equal grid cell; no components cross gutters. Transparent alpha including gaps, no white matte. No ground line. No characters except the one profile head.

Create a flat vector-look COLOR-BLOCK LANDSCAPE of a small welcoming town for a minimalist English-learning app. Wide3:1 horizontal composition, the town fills the lower two-thirds, transparent sky and outer margins. No typography or labels. A single solid cream pedestrian path links the buildings. No people. All buildings are straight-on geometric silhouettes with friendly softened corners; no perspective modeling. ABSOLUTELY FLAT PRINT-SIGN DESIGN, as if assembled from separate shapes of opaque colored paper. Each shape has one constant color. Limited palette: magenta#ad195a, teal#008f95, orange#ff7900, navy#163d50, cream#ffe8bc and green#6d9e38. No gradients, texture, noise, shading, lighting, outlines, strokes, borders, drop shadows, cast shadows, ground shadows, glossy details, or3D. No color modulation across a shape. Clean transparent alpha outside the silhouette; no matte/glow/haze or colored debris. Entire scene fits with generous transparent margins. This is one finished STILL image, no animation frames or disassembled parts. Reference is only for simple geometric solid-color vocabulary, not its existing characters.
